description:
Compute the difference between two ISO 8601 timestamps in days, hours, minutes, and seconds.

Returns: JSON with milliseconds, totalSeconds/Minutes/Hours/Days, and a { days, hours, minutes, seconds } breakdown.
Example input: {"from":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z","to":"2026-07-11T12:00:00Z"}
On error, includes hint: Both `from` and `to` must be ISO 8601 timestamps.
name: date_diff
title: Date difference
